turns.text: Hi, I would like to book a tattoo.
Hi! What tattoo do you have in mind? Please share the approximate size, where you’d like it on your body, and which days or times generally work for you.
The idea is a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of my left forearm. I can come on weekday evenings.

Thanks! I’ve passed along your idea for an 8 cm paper boat tattoo on the outside of your left forearm, along with your weekday evening availability. A colleague will take over from here. No appointment has been booked yet.

input.summary: Customer wants to book a paper boat tattoo, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of their left forearm. Available weekday evenings.
